verdict.rationale: Docs mention an interactive Playground where you can try Perplexity Search with no API key required, offering a limited free way to experiment, but there's no explicit free tier or free credit allotment described for the actual Sonar API itself — usage tiers are described only in terms of paid spend advancing rate limits. missing for 10: explicit free-tier/free-credit program for API access, sign-up free credit amount, and confirmation that this extends beyond the Search product playground to full Sonar API usage.
